item.title: Charleston County housing initiative provides $6.6M in funds for 200 units
item.description: Charleston County awards $6.6M from the Housing Our Future Trust Fund to support near-ly 200 affordable and workforce housing units. The post Charleston County housing initiative provides $6.6M in funds for 200 units appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: SC NEXUS launches energy innovation accelerator
item.description: SC NEXUS and SCRA launch eiX in Greenville to accelerate advanced energy innovation and commercialize grid-resilient technologies. The post SC NEXUS launches energy innovation accelerator appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: VantagePoint Marketing names Dave McQuaid CEO
item.description: VantagePoint Marketing in Greenville names Dave McQuaid president and CEO, succeeding Henry Pellerin after more than 20 years with the B2B agency. The post VantagePoint Marketing names Dave McQuaid CEO appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Meet the new leader behind SC Ports logistics boon
item.description: Micah Mallace returns as president and CEO of South Carolina Ports Authority, outlining plans to boost competitiveness, efficiency and growth. The post Meet the new leader behind SC Ports logistics boon appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: North Charleston equestrian tech startup receives $200,000 investment
item.description: SC Launch Inc., an affiliate of South Carolina Research Authority, invests $200,000 in North Charleston-based Horse Spot, an equestrian software startup. The post North Charleston equestrian tech startup receives $200,000 investment appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Blue Ridge Electric CEO to retire, successor named
item.description: Blue Ridge Electric Co-op CEO Jim Lovinggood will retire after 44 years. The board named Zachary Hinton as successor, effective January 2027. The post Blue Ridge Electric CEO to retire, successor named appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: SOCO Gather opens at Gather COLA in BullStreet
item.description: SOCO Gather opens at Gather COLA in Columbia’s BullStreet District, offering 9,500 square feet of coworking space, private offices and event space. The post SOCO Gather opens at Gather COLA in BullStreet appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Scott Woods’ lifelong journey with SC Federal
item.description: Scott Woods marks 22 years as president and CEO of South Carolina Federal Credit Union, leading growth from $800 million to $2.5 billion. The post Scott Woods’ lifelong journey with SC Federal appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Punching above its weight: SC’s $38B trade engine
item.description: South Carolina exports hit $38 billion in 2024, ranking No. 17 nationally, fueled by manufacturing, Charleston Port logistics and workforce growth. The post Punching above its weight: SC’s $38B trade engine appeared first on SCBiz.
